name: setup-manaflow-ai-tonal-look
description: A whole cmux look in which every color comes from one seed through tonal palettes: the page, the chrome a few tone steps off it, selection and Send in the primary. Opaque surfaces instead of glass, tone instead of shadows and hairlines, the work in one rounded card, a filled primary Send. Three seeds ship: Tonal (sage-teal, airy, the default), Tonal Ink (indigo-violet, vivid containers) and Tonal Clay (terracotta, warm and dense), each in Light and Dark. Remove it and everything you had comes back.

// Tonal Clay Dark: a tonal look in Dark. Every color comes from one seed (#b5573a, a terracotta seed, warm and dense)
// through tonal palettes: the chrome is a few tone steps off the page, so tone, not shadow or
// glass, tells one surface from another; the primary does selection, focus, Send and links.
// Opaque everywhere. Its twin is Tonal Clay. Generated by gen_palette.py; edit the seed, not the hexes.
{
  "name": "Tonal Clay Dark",
  "description": "Dark: a terracotta seed; warm neutrals and dense proportions; opaque tonal surfaces, the primary as the accent.",

  "appearance.theme": "Builtin Dark",
  "appearance.appTheme": "followTerminal",
  // background: the page (surface). foreground: on-surface. selection: primary-container.
  // accent: primary, so Send, focus rings and links are the one strong color.
  "colors": { "background": "#1a110f", "foreground": "#ede0db", "selection": "#812807", "accent": "#ffb59e" },
  "appearance.accent": "theme",
  // The terminal: the page and ink above, the cursor in the primary, and sixteen ANSI colors at one
  // chroma, each tone solved over the page (1-6 at least 6.23:1, 9-14 at least 10.88:1,
  // 7 on-surface; 0 the raised black and 8 the dim gray kept to about 2:1 and 3:1).
  "ghostty": [
    "background = #1a110f",
    "foreground = #ede0db",
    "cursor-color = #ffb59e",
    "cursor-text = #5b1a04",
    "selection-background = #812807",
    "selection-foreground = #fddbd1",
    "palette = 0=#4f4441",
    "palette = 1=#e47569",
    "palette = 2=#68a54a",
    "palette = 3=#bf8e23",
    "palette = 4=#6f93ed",
    "palette = 5=#d078bd",
    "palette = 6=#20a79d",
    "palette = 7=#ede0db",
    "palette = 8=#725f59",
    "palette = 9=#fbb5ac",
    "palette = 10=#9dd683",
    "palette = 11=#f1bf60",
    "palette = 12=#aec6fe",
    "palette = 13=#fbaee9",
    "palette = 14=#43dccf",
    "palette = 15=#fff8f6"
  ],
  "terminal.fontFamily": "SF Mono",
  "terminal.fontSize": 12,

  // Material: none. No wallpaper, no blur, no glass, no tint from the desktop: each surface is one
  // opaque tone.
  "appearance.background": "none",
  "appearance.backgroundBlur": "none",
  "appearance.backgroundOpacity": 1,
  "appearance.glassTransparency": 0,
  "appearance.wallpaperTint": false,
  "appearance.fontSmoothing": "antialiased",
  "browser.omnibar.glass": "off",

  // Layout: the work is one rounded card (12 pt, the card step of the corner scale) set into
  // the tonal chrome, no hairlines (tone separates), the selected tab a pill, inactive tabs tonal.
  "appearance.chromeStyle": "card",
  "appearance.borders": "none",
  "appearance.titleAreaTone": "subtleTone",
  "appearance.cornerFlush": "off",
  "appearance.focusIndicator": "tabs",
  "focus.inactiveTabStyle": "tonal",
  "appearance.density": "compact",
  "layout.paneCornerRadius": 12,
  "layout.cornerPadding": 4,

  // Proportions.
  "appearance.metrics.titlebarHeight": 36,
  "appearance.metrics.sidebarWidth": 232,
  "appearance.metrics.sidebarRowHeight": 28,
  "appearance.metrics.chromeFontSize": 12,
  "appearance.metrics.tabStripHeight": 30,
  "appearance.metrics.tabFontSize": 12,
  "appearance.metrics.columnGap": 4,
  "appearance.metrics.dividerThickness": 0,

  // The sidebar: its own tonal step (surface-container), no edge line, groups in the theme's colors.
  "appearance.sidebarSurface": "separate",
  "appearance.surfaces.sidebar.color": "#271d1a",
  "appearance.surfaces.sidebar.opacity": 1,
  "sidebar.style": "standard",
  "sidebar.border": false,
  "sidebar.density": "compact",
  "sidebar.sectionLook": "lines",
  "sidebar.groupPalette": "theme",

  // The card: the page (surface) under the chat, terminal, editor, diffs and Markdown; the tab strip
  // surface-container-low; the browser's bar and docks surface-container-low; dividers the chrome's own tone.
  "appearance.surfaces.agentPane.color": "#1a110f",
  "appearance.surfaces.agentPane.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.terminal.color": "#1a110f",
  "appearance.surfaces.terminal.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.editor.color": "#1a110f",
  "appearance.surfaces.editor.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.diff.color": "#1a110f",
  "appearance.surfaces.diff.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.markdown.color": "#1a110f",
  "appearance.surfaces.markdown.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.tabBar.color": "#231917",
  "appearance.surfaces.tabBar.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.browserChrome.color": "#231917",
  "appearance.surfaces.browserChrome.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.docks.color": "#231917",
  "appearance.surfaces.docks.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.splitDivider.color": "#271d1a",
  "appearance.surfaces.splitDivider.opacity": 1,

  // Settings and pages: surface-container-low, one step off the page.
  "appearance.surfaces.settings.color": "#231917",
  "appearance.surfaces.settings.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.internalPage.color": "#231917",
  "appearance.surfaces.internalPage.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.newTabPage.color": "#231917",
  "appearance.surfaces.newTabPage.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.home.color": "#231917",
  "appearance.surfaces.home.opacity": 1,

  // Type: the system face in the chat at 13 pt with a 1.45 line height, code at 0.9.
  "agentPane.display.font.ui": "system-ui",
  "agentPane.display.font.preset": "system",
  "agentPane.display.font.size": 13,
  "agentPane.display.font.lineHeight": 1.45,
  "agentPane.display.code.scale": 0.9,

  // Status: a quiet dot on rows and tabs.
  "appearance.statusIndicator.style": "dot",
  "appearance.statusIndicator.showAgentWorkingOnTabs": true,

  // Motion: standard easing, short, no overshoot; color changes cross in OKLab.
  "ui.animationSpeed": "normal",
  "appearance.colorTransition.enabled": true,
  "appearance.colorTransition.curve": "easeOut",
  "appearance.colorTransition.duration": 200,
  "appearance.colorTransition.colorSpace": "oklab",
  "appearance.colorTransition.reduceMotion": "crossfade"

  // Not reachable from a theme file yet (no key): the toast's shape and fill, the sidebar row's
  // corner radius and inset, the composer's radius (28), the dialog/sheet radius (28), menus'
  // radius, the tab shape (pending cmux#46780), a neutral (tonal) selected row (pending cmux#46516).
}
